review.rationale: The sole live blocking finding at revision 22 is the Playwright trace-lifecycle conflict. The retry candidate directly and narrowly remedies that conflict by replacing manual context tracing with runner-managed tracing and requires the focused browser gate, current-source gates, and independent review. It preserves the approved scope and introduces no unsafe product or deployment action. Under an operator-attested private-source policy, the revised audit is sufficient because it binds the observed manager proposal to snapshot.proposal and decision-packet candidates, while negative tests demonstrate rejection of independent mismatches.
evidence: Attempt 2 establishes R14-01 and R14-02 as repaired, leaving R14-03 as the only blocking finding.
Candidate retry-phase5-trace-lifecycle explicitly targets R14-03 and identifies the retained manual-tracing mechanism as the change from the previous attempt.
The candidate requires rerunning the focused browser validation, typecheck, tests, build, and independent review before completion.

audit-source.ts verifies the exact observed manager proposal call against manager-proposal.json, digest-binds that proposal to snapshot.proposal, and digest-binds decision-packet.json candidates to the proposal candidates.
audit-negative-checks.json reports rejection when snapshot.proposal is mutated and when packet.candidates is mutated independently.
The packet digest matches runtime-shadow-outcome.json and source-provenance.json.
The supplied audit records consistent session, revision, source digest, reviewer results, and retained-source digests.
limitations: This review used only the supplied sanitized files and did not access or independently hash the retained private raw bytes.
Source authenticity is sufficient only under the stated operator-attested private-source policy; it is not independently reproducible without the retained private files.
The evidence does not cryptographically prove remote provider execution or model identity.
The runtime shadow outcome abstained and selected no candidate; acceptableSelections is an independent review determination, not a claim that runtime selected it.
The candidate is provisionally effective as a recovery action; successful trace production remains to be demonstrated by the required retry validations.

reviewScope: Sanitized revision-22 case bundle, revised source-audit code/result, and four negative checks; private raw bytes and later task outcome were not supplied.
